name: AI UI Style Vault Runtime Index
purpose: Keep agent context small by routing each task to only the files needed for the current stage.

sourceIngestion.when: user provides a Google Maps/business/site/social/directory URL or structured business-source evidence
read: the single source playbook selected by the URL router
produce: business-source-request.json when URL research is required
sourceIngestion.rule: Verified/source values are not rewritten or substituted. Reviews marked verbatim remain exact. Unsupported fields stay omitted/empty. Read only the selected source playbook, not all playbooks.

contentModel.when: a source-ingestion bundle exists and the build may need evidence-backed public content structure or admin/CMS functionality
contentModel.rule: Only evidenced entities become public/CMS records. Missing evidence never creates placeholder operational modules, sample data or dashboard statistics.

research.when: real business, brand, organisation, venue, product or service without a completed source-ingestion bundle

plan.rule: Only expand into selected requiredReads and recipes.

components.when: interaction or component semantics are non-trivial

effects.when: the static/component composition is valid and an interactive enhancement may materially support the page purpose
read: references/threeui-community.json only when reference research is needed
effects.rule: None is a first-class result. Business purpose, accessibility, mobile behavior and measured performance outrank novelty. Route to 3D when the subject becomes explorable/configurable/spatially meaningful.

3d.when: 3D is justified by subject and user goal
3d.rule: Do not load the full 478-recipe registry unless selection needs it.

commands: python scripts/vault-agent.py effect-qa <effect-id> EFFECT_QA_OBSERVATIONS.json when an effect is selected

studio.when: a human or agent needs a compact browse index instead of reading the full reference archive
studio.rule: Studio browsing never bypasses business research, semantic effect selection or source/licence boundaries.

mcp.when: a local MCP-capable coding agent needs compact read-only effect discovery/selection and skill retrieval
mcp.rule: The initial MCP adapter is local/read-only; it does not perform business-source web research, write files or bypass third-party entitlements.

contextBudgetRules: For business URLs, ingest source evidence before design catalogs.
Generate the content/CMS model before inventing an admin structure.
Load exactly one source-specific extraction playbook for the primary URL unless a second source is explicitly inspected.
Select an interactive effect before opening any external effect implementation; none is valid.
Never preload all 2,671 Component Gallery examples.
Never preload all captured styles or screen references.
Prefer a generated plan containing file pointers over duplicated prose.
A selected pack's requiredReads are authoritative for that task; unrelated packs stay out of context.
